notes: Every packet-send method is judged by whether the message it would send is represented in the replay's struct message queues (s2c_queue in survival.h), not by a socket. Chat, client settings and keepalive are n/a because nothing consumes them. The chunk-send half of onUpdate is partial: sr_player_send_chunks covers the send, but the S26 bulk batching is not a byte-level port. lane/idxentity: the partials were message-format folds (structs, not bytes) or out-of-play branches; each is described in its member note.
